name: Green Balloon
displayDescription: Buying this game pass will get you a green balloon every time you spawn. This balloon can help you stay aloft, taking less fall damage, and allowing you to jump to new heights. Have fun out there!

name: Red Apple
displayDescription: Buying this game pass will get you a Red Apple every time you spawn. This apple is as tasty as it is healthy. Gain health with every bite you take; it never expires! Have fun out there!

name: Yellow Compass
displayDescription: Buying this game pass will get you a yellow compass every time you spawn. This compass will let you pick the map, guiding you to the places that you want to explore. Have fun out there!
